item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Cornerstone Community Centers provide engaging activities year-round for young people and adults. Programs are located at 99 New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) Community Centers throughout the five boroughs, and were shaped by input from young people, NYCHA residents, Resident Association leaders, elected officials, and principals at schools that serve youth who live in the participating developments.

item.title: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration — Special Materials: NYCBenefits Concept Paper - 06926Y0443
item.description:
Outcome: Special Materials
Notice of Concept Paper The NYC Department of Social Service (DSS)/Human Resources Administration (HRA) is committed to strengthening and modernizing the NYCBenefits Program to promote accountability, workforce capacity, cross-system coordination, and high-quality, client-centered services. The purpose of this document is to: Outline HRA s proposed enhancements to the NYCBenefits service model; Solicit stakeholder feedback regarding program design and operational requirements; Assess provider interest and organizational capacity; and Inform the development of a Request for Proposals (RFP)/RFx.
